description: Price and market cap of any token by its contract address. A 0x address is read on Robinhood Chain by default (Uniswap v3 and v4 pools; when the best pool is thin, under $2,000 in range, or missing, the price comes from a $10 buy routed by 0x and a warning says so); pass chain hyperevm, elysium, base, ethereum or arbitrum for those chains. A Solana mint is priced from a small USDC buy routed across Solana DEXes.
